ValidationRule.description:
Admin and Users with 'Conference Meeting Request Edit' Permission Set is allowed to update the Status field on 'Conference Meeting Request' ISR Record Type.
5.1.26 Added NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')) for the ISBLANK fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.Name = 'Conference Meeting Request', OR( ISCHANGED(Status__c), AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')) ), ISCHANGED(Date_of_Meeting__c), ISCHANGED(Time_of_Meeting__c), ISCHANGED(Meeting_Address__c), ISCHANGED(Time_Zone__c), ISCHANGED(Sr_Advisor_Monthly_Updates__c), AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Date_of_Meeting__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Sr_Advisor_Monthly_Updates__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Time_Zone__c, '')), NOT(ISBLANK(Meeting_Address__c)), OR( TEXT(HOUR(Time_of_Meeting__c)) <> "8", TEXT(MINUTE(Time_of_Meeting__c)) <> "0" ) ) ) ), NOT($Profile.Name = 'Tanium System Administrator'), NOT($Permission.Conference_Meeting_Request_Edit_Access) )

AND( ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Date_of_Meeting__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Sr_Advisor_Monthly_Updates__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Time_Zone__c, '')), NOT(ISBLANK(Meeting_Address__c)),
OR( TEXT(HOUR(Time_of_Meeting__c)) <> "8", TEXT(MINUTE(Time_of_Meeting__c)) <> "0" ) ) ) ),
NOT($Profile.Name = 'Tanium System Administrator'), NOT($Permission.Conference_Meeting_Request_Edit_Access) )*/
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Update of Status, Date of Meeting, Time of Meeting, Time Zone & Meeting Location fields are not allowed. Please blank out these fields and submit for approval when ready
